purpose.intro: The seed orchestrator: versioned workers and pipelines run on Trigger.dev, every artifact in object storage, one gated API in front. Design and glossary: `slice-design/projects/seed-orchestrator` (exploration "Orchestrator API and its concepts"; v7 is the as-built record).

snippets.code:
apps/orchestrator/
  registry.ts              what this project runs: each pipeline and the roles that may start it
  trigger.config.ts        the Trigger.dev project (cloud)
  shared/
    env.ts · db.ts · storage.ts   once-only init (SCF10)
    api/                   index.ts (entrypoint, composition root) · app.ts (the factory) · middlewares
                           routes/index.ts · services/{files,pipelines,runs} · lib/{http,openapi}
    ontology/              vocabulary.ts, capabilities.ts (as const: every id is a type)
    runtime/               slot · envelope · validate · pipeline · usage · storage · run
                           worker.ts (contracts, one step) · run-pipeline.ts (the task, one run, its steps)
                           models/ and repositories/ of the run store
    workers/index.ts       every worker version, one line each
    workers/<id>/v<N>/     contract.ts (meta, config, input, output) · worker.ts
    trigger/tasks.ts       run-pipeline, the one Trigger.dev task
    lib/                   pure helpers
  slices/
    seed/<slice>/pipelines/<id>/v<N>/pipeline.ts
    product/<slice>/pipelines/<id>/v<N>/pipeline.ts

reference.statement: Nothing is generated: the registry, the worker list and the ontology are imported, so the compiler checks every id, version and slot.

claims.text: To watch runs live (for demos): `pnpm --filter @apps/orchestrator run-viewer`, then open http://localhost:4010. It reads the run store directly and prices each run as if on Trigger.dev, from `_meta/research/orchestrator/run-viewer/pricing.json`.

snippets.code:
pnpm docker:up && pnpm docker:up:orchestrator     # main's localstack (S3) + the orchestrator's postgres (:5444)
cd apps/orchestrator && bash setup.sh             # .env, the Qwen model, LibreOffice check
pnpm --filter @apps/orchestrator db:push
ollama serve                                       # Qwen transcribes scanned pages
pnpm dev:orchestrator                              # the api on :4003; TRIGGER_MODE=inline runs tasks in-process
pnpm --filter @apps/orchestrator test:e2e          # upload → run → poll → assert the artifacts
snippets.caption: bash

snippets.code:
T=$(pnpm --filter @apps/orchestrator token --role agent | tail -1)
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $T" -F file=@doc.pdf localhost:4003/uploads
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $T" -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"input":{"document":{"type":"type-text","format":"format-pdf","ref":"<the ref>"}}}' \
  localhost:4003/pipelines/document-to-text/runs
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $T" localhost:4003/runs/<run id>
snippets.caption: bash

reference.statement: A token for curl: `pnpm --filter @apps/orchestrator token --role agent`.

claims.text: `shared/workers/<id>/v1/contract.ts` — `meta` (the capability, an id in `shared/ontology/capabilities.ts`, and the vendor), `config` (Zod, with defaults), `input` and `output` slot maps. A slot is `slot("type-image", {...})` for content or `slot({ formats: [...] })` for a file; the output may be a function of the config.
`worker.ts` — `export const run: WorkerRun<typeof contract>`; it reads its input refs from `ctx.artifacts`, does the work, stores its outputs with `ctx.artifacts`, reports usage with `ctx.report`.
A unit test under `__test__/unit/workers/` with the vendor mocked; a live check with `pnpm run-worker <id> <file> '{config}'`.

`slices/<seed|product>/<slice>/pipelines/<id>/v1/pipeline.ts` — default-export `pipeline({ id, version, input, output, maxCredits, machine, maxDuration }, body)`. The body calls `ctx.worker(id, input, { config, version, step })`.
Import it in `registry.ts` with the `roles` that may start it. To ship a new version, import the new folder instead; the old one stays in the code.
Checks: `pnpm --filter @apps/orchestrator typecheck`, `lint`, `test:unit`; repo-wide `pnpm lint:arch` and `pnpm validate:scaffolding` (node ≥ 22.6).

reference.statement: `trigger login` once, then `TRIGGER_PROJECT_REF`, `TRIGGER_SECRET_KEY` and `CLOUD_DATABASE_URL` in `.env`; `pnpm --filter @apps/orchestrator deploy` (add `--dry-run` first). The API triggers `run-pipeline` with the pipeline's machine and time limit in the environment its secret key names; the tasks read `DATABASE_URL` and the S3 variables pushed at deploy.
